TRG-42.description: A Suomira bolt-action rifle. Higher-than-average velocity with a fast reload, but slow bolt chambering action.
TRG-42.name: TRG-42

REMINGTON 700.description: A classic Grand Federation bolt-action sniper with a Magpul polymer frame. Middle-of-the-road in all respects.
REMINGTON 700.name: REMINGTON 700

WA2000.description:
A semi-automatic bullpup Eisenmarkian sniper rifle intended for law enforcement as a counter-terrorist weapon. Very few were made, making it highly sought after. Fast fire rate, moderate damage, poor recoil control.
Section 26, paragraph 5 - need to know. I'm sure you understand.

Remodeled by Mysterious Modeler X.
WA2000.name: WA2000

BFG 50.description:
A Grand Federation anti-materiel rifle. Hits like a truck, but only chambers a single round, necessitating frequent reloads.

Model submitted by Rialag.
BFG 50.name: BFG 50

attachmentModifiers.info: Lightened stock with a simplified buttstock and pistol grip.

HECATE II.description: A magazine-fed .50 BMG rifle with relatively middling stats for the caliber. What it lacks in the punch or rate of fire of other .50 BMG snipers, it makes up for in consistency.
HECATE II.name: HECATE II

AWS.description: A suppressed version of the L115A3 firing a smaller cartridge. Suffers from reduced velocity, but feeds from a 10 round magazine, with middling firerate.
AWS.name: AWS

CS/LR-4A.description:
The CS/LR-4A is a high precision sniper utilizing a specially designed CS/DFL3 7.62x51mm cartridge, though it can accept standard .308 ammunition.

The gun was designed as a replacement for the JS 7.62mm and is in used with Jinhanian police detachments.

Community submitted model.
CS/LR-4A.name: CS/LR-4A

FT300.description:
A Helzevian competition rifle developed by Grünig & Elmiger.
This rifle, going by the moniker of the 'Free Rifle'. This rifle sees use not in combat, but in shooting events in competitions. Featuring a lot of unique traits and ammo types keeping the most seasoned shooter entertained.
How will you use it?
FT300.name: FT300
